# Supported beds

<!-- Generated by tools/sync_adjustable_bed.py; do not edit. -->

HomeKit Adjustable Bed is checked against [Adjustable Bed](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed) **v4.2.3** ([`55a497d`](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed/commit/55a497d685efbd3fb4d1d140419f48cf98d499a4)). Every bed type below works: HomeKit Adjustable Bed reads the entities Adjustable Bed creates for your bed, so a bed only gets the controls it really has. See [Detection](DETECTION.md) for the rules.

## Controls (670 entity keys)

Per group of the form, the number of entity keys (side variants count separately) and how they are recognised: by a rule, by a word in the key (a vendor control without a rule, off by default) or only by its domain (off by default, under Settings).

| Group | Keys | Rule | Keyword | Domain only | On by default |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Adjustable sections | 195 | 185 | 10 | 0 | 143 |
| Quick actions | 117 | 111 | 6 | 0 | 75 |
| Massage | 161 | 107 | 54 | 0 | 27 |
| Lighting | 79 | 37 | 42 | 0 | 13 |
| Climate | 16 | 13 | 3 | 0 | 7 |
| Firmness | 7 | 3 | 4 | 0 | 3 |
| Settings | 95 | 6 | 58 | 31 | 0 |

HomeKit types: push button 412, slider 180, switch per option 55, switch 10, fan (climate) 6, lamp 6, fan 1.

Timed adjustments (`adjustable_bed.timed_move`): `tv_lift`, `back`, `right_back`, `legs`, `head`, `feet`, `tilt`, `lumbar`, `bed_height`, `stair`.
